title: Battery Life
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Battery
learningObjectives: Calculate battery runtime in hours by dividing capacity in mAh by the load's average current draw in mA
Convert a battery rating from Watt-hours to Amp-hours by dividing by the nominal cell voltage
Compare the capacities of a CR2032 coin cell, AA and AAA alkaline packs, a 9V battery, and an 18650 LiPo cell
Predict how switching a load from a 2 mA dim LED to a 1,024 mA LED matrix shortens runtime by roughly 500 times
Evaluate which battery and device pairing meets a target runtime measured in hours, days, or weeks
